youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Visiting a Bookstore
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用逛書店情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從進店找區問推薦、翻閱比較小說童書工具書、缺書預訂與會員簽售活動，到結帳包裝、咖啡區小坐、辦卡離店，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Visiting a Bookstore phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole bookstore trip: finding sections and asking for recommendations, comparing novels, kids' books and references, reserving sold-out titles and joining events, then checkout, gift wrapping, the cafe and getting a membership card. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, are you open right now?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你們現在營業嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we close at ten tonight.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我們今晚十點打烊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I just want to look around.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪ dʒʌst wɑnt tə lʊk əˈraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我想先隨便看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, feel free to browse anywhere.
dialogue.zh: 當然，哪裡都可以逛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place is bigger than I expected.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pleɪs ɪz ˈbɪɡər ðæn aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這裡比我想像的大多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have three floors of books.
dialogue.zh: 我們有三層的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find new arrivals?
dialogue.zh: 新書在哪裡找？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are on the table near the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðe ɑr ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl nɪr ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 在靠窗那張桌子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am looking for a mystery novel.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈlʊkɪŋ fər ə ˈmɪstəri ˈnɑvəl/
dialogue.zh: 我想找一本推理小說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mysteries are in aisle four, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪstəriz ɑr ɪn aɪl fɔr raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 推理小說在第四通道，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aisle four, thanks for pointing it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɔr θæŋks fər ˈpɔɪntɪŋ ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 第四通道，謝謝你告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to help, we sell lots of those.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə hɛlp wi sɛl lɑts əv ðoz/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，那種書我們賣很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are travel books in here too?
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡也有旅遊書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, downstairs by the big maps.
dialogue.zh: 有，在樓下大地圖旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I need one for Japan.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我需要一本日本的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The Japan guides are very popular here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒəˈpæn ɡaɪdz ɑr ˈvɛri ˈpɑpjələr hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 日本指南在這裡很搶手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the cookbook section far from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈkʊkˌbʊk ˈsɛkʃən fɑr frʌm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 食譜區離這裡遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not far, it is next to the coffee bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fɑr ɪt ɪz nɛkst tə ðə ˈkɔˌfi bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 不遠，就在咖啡吧旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, I love browsing cookbooks.
dialogue.zh: 喔真好，我愛翻食譜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should try the dessert shelf.
dialogue.zh: 你一定要看看甜點那一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly is the kids corner?
dialogue.zh: 兒童區確切在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is through that door, with soft chairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz θru ðæt dɔr wɪð sɔft tʃɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 穿過那扇門，有軟軟的椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a birthday gift for my nephew.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə ˈbɜrtˌdeɪ ɡɪft fər maɪ ˈnɛvju/
dialogue.zh: 我想給姪子買個生日禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Picture books make a lovely present.
dialogue.zh: 繪圖書是很棒的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is five, and he loves dinosaurs.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiː ɪz faɪv ænd hi lʌvz ˈdaɪnəˌsɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 他五歲，最愛恐龍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the big dino book is perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə bɪɡ ˈdɪnoʊ bʊk ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 那本大恐龍書最適合他了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one with the roaring sound page?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði wʌn wɪð ðə ˈrɔrɪŋ saʊnd peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 是有吼聲那一頁的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, children love that sound page.
dialogue.zh: 對，小孩都愛那一頁的吼聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the one for him, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə wʌn fər hɪm ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就送他這本了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the low shelf by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə loʊ ʃɛlf baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 在門邊矮架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a station for greeting cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈsteɪʃən fər ˈɡritɪŋ kɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 有賣賀卡的區域嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right beside the checkout counter.
dialogue.zh: 有，就在收銀台旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Besides books, do you sell bookmarks?
dialogue.zh: 除了書，你們也賣書籤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have pretty bookmarks near the register.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ˈprɪti ˈbʊkˌmɑrks nɪr ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər/
dialogue.zh: 收銀台附近有漂亮的書籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I also need notebooks for class.
dialogue.zh: 我還要買上課用的筆記本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stationery is on the second shelf.
dialogue.zh: 文具在第二層架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These paper ones feel really nice.
dialogue.zh: 這些紙本的質感真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are made by a local shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðe ɑr meɪd baɪ ə ˈloʊkəl ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 是本地店家做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I try a book before buying?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ traɪ ə bʊk bɪˈfɔr ˈbaɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡可以先試翻再買？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any reading chair is fine, please sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈridɪŋ tʃɛr ɪz faɪn pliz sɪt/
dialogue.zh: 任意閱讀椅都可以，請坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to read here for a while?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ tə rid hɪr fər ə waɪl/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡看一陣子可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, lots of people do that.
dialogue.zh: 當然，很多顧客都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are staff picks marked anywhere?
dialogue.zh: 店員推薦有標示出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, see the little cards by the stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs si ðə ˈlɪtəl kɑrdz baɪ ðə stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 有，樓梯旁的小卡片就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who picked this strange cover story?
dialogue.zh: 這本封面古怪的書是誰挑的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was our manager, she loves it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ˈaʊər ˈmænɪdʒər ʃi lʌvz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是我們經理挑的，她很愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I trust her taste, I will read it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ trʌst hər teɪst aɪ wɪl rid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我信她的品味，會來讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can thank her when you visit again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn θæŋk hər wɛn ju ˈvɪzɪt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 下次來再當面謝她吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about a corner just for poetry?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ə ˈkɔːrnər dʒʌst fər ˈpoʊətri/
dialogue.zh: 那有專門放詩集的角落嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small one, up near the art books.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl wʌn æp nɪr ði ɑrt bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 有一小區，在藝術書附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these audiobooks sold separately?
dialogue.zh: 這些有聲書是單獨賣的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They come as codes inside the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðe kʌm æz koʊdz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 是盒子裡的兌換碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I need special software to play them?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl aɪ nid ˈspɛʃəl ˈsɔftˌwɛr tə pleɪ ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 播放它們需要特定軟體嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just our free app on your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈaʊər fri æp ɑn jɔr foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 用手機裝我們的免費程式就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend is looking for a book too.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd ɪz ˈlʊkɪŋ fər ə bʊk tu/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友也想找一本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, what do you remember?
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，您還記得什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I forgot the author's exact name.
dialogue.zh: 我忘了作者的準確名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Describe the cover, we can search it.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪsˈkraɪb ðə ˈkʌvər wi kæn sɜrtʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 描述一下封面，我們幫你查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It had a blue train on the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæd ə blu treɪn ɑn ðə frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 封面前麵有一輛藍色的火車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, I think I know that one already.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ θɪŋk aɪ noʊ ðæt wʌn ɔːlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 喔，我想我已經知道是哪本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you put in special orders for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju pʊt ɪn ˈspɛʃəl ˈɔːrdərz fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 你們會幫我訂特殊的書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can note anything you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi kæn noʊt ˈɛnɪˌθɪŋ ju wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，想要的都能幫你記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I use that computer by the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ juːz ðæt kəmˈpjutər baɪ ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 牆邊那台電腦怎麼用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type the name, it shows the shelf number.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ðə neɪm ɪt ʃoʊz ðə ʃɛlf ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 輸入書名，它會顯示架位號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the wifi password written somewhere?
dialogue.zh: 哪裡有寫無線網路密碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the card beside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə kɑrd bɪˈsaɪd ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 在門邊那張卡片上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, my phone died on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks maɪ foʊn deɪd ɑn ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我手機路上沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a charger at the counter, free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈtʃɑrdʒər æt ðə ˈkaʊntər fri/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台有免費充電線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone here is so helpful.
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡的人真貼心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We love matching readers with books.
dialogue.zh: 我們最愛幫讀者配對好書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these tables the weekly discounts?
dialogue.zh: 這桌上是每週特價書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everything here is half price.
dialogue.zh: 對，這區全部半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half price? That is a real deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf praɪs ðæt ɪz ə ril dil/
dialogue.zh: 半價？這真的很划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rack changes every Friday morning.
dialogue.zh: 書架每週五早上都會換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a bargain bin further in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈbɑrɡən bɪn ˈfɜrðər ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 裡面還有更便宜的書箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three for one dollar at the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs θri fər wʌn ˈdɑlər æt ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 有，最後面一美元三本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take photos of the shelves?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz əv ðə ʃɛlvz/
dialogue.zh: 我可以拍書架的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photos are fine, just no flash please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ɑr faɪn dʒʌst noʊ flæʃ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 可以拍，但請關閃光燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any bags for these thick books?
dialogue.zh: 有裝這些厚書的袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper bags are free under the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər bæɡz ɑr fri ˈʌndər ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 紙袋免費，在櫃台下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep large print editions?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju kip lɑrdʒ prɪnt ɪˈdɪʒənz/
dialogue.zh: 大字版放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aisle six, the shelf with yellow signs.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɪks ðə ʃɛlf wɪð ˈjɛloʊ saɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 第六通道，掛黃色標牌那排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My grandma reads with her glasses.
dialogue.zh: 我奶奶要戴眼鏡看書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will love these nice big letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl lʌv ðiz naɪs bɪɡ ˈlɛtərz/
dialogue.zh: 她一定會喜歡這些又大又清楚的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep the magazines?
dialogue.zh: 雜誌放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the entrance, on the spinning rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ði ˈɛntrəns ɑn ðə ˈspɪnɪŋ ræk/
dialogue.zh: 入口處的旋轉架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights are warm and cozy here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts ɑr wɔrm ænd ˈkoʊzi hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡燈光溫暖又舒適。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We want reading to feel relaxing.
dialogue.zh: 我們想讓閱讀變成放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What music is playing in the store?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət ˈmjuːzɪk ɪz ˈpleɪɪŋ ɪn ðə stɔr/
dialogue.zh: 店裡放的是什麼音樂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just soft jazz, low and calm.
dialogue.zh: 只是輕柔爵士，低音量很平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave my jacket somewhere?
dialogue.zh: 我的外套可以先放著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hooks are just behind you there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hʊks ɑr dʒʌst bɪˈhaɪnd ju ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 掛鉤就在你身後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this stool free to sit on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs stuːl fri tə sɪt ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 這張凳子可以自由坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please make yourself at home.
dialogue.zh: 可以，請當自己家一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the bathroom in this building?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈbæθˌrum ɪn ðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這棟樓的洗手間在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the hall, past the art section.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ðə hɔl pæst ði ɑrt ˈsɛkʃən/
dialogue.zh: 走廊過去，穿過藝術區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You clearly love working here.
dialogue.zh: 你顯然很愛在這裡工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Books make the day pass quickly.
dialogue.zh: 有書相伴時間過得飛快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will visit every shelf before leaving.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈvɪzɪt ˈɛvri ʃɛlf bɪˈfɔr ˈlivɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 離開前我要把每排都逛一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, we are not busy yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm wi ɑr nɑt ˈbɪzi jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢逛，現在還不算忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This novel feels heavier than it looks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈnɑvəl filz ˈhɛviər ðæn ɪt lʊks/
dialogue.zh: 這本書比看起來重多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost five hundred pages, quite a ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌmoʊst faɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈpeɪdʒɪz kwaɪt ə raɪd/
dialogue.zh: 將近五百頁，讀起來很過癮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I finished my last book just Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fɪˈnɪʃtd maɪ læst bʊk dʒʌst ˈtuzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我週二才剛讀完上一本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, reading grows on you fast.
dialogue.zh: 看吧，閱讀的習慣很快就養成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me flip through these first pages.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi flɪp θru ðiz fɜrst ˈpeɪdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 讓我先翻翻前面幾頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chapters are short, very easy to read.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃæptərz ɑr ʃɔrt ˈvɛri ˈizi tə rid/
dialogue.zh: 章節很短，非常好讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The opening line already caught me.
dialogue.zh: 開頭第一句就抓住我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That usually means you will buy it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈjuʒəwəli minz ju wɪl baɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那通常就代表你會買單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know readers a little too well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ ˈridərz ə ˈlɪtəl tu wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 你也太了解讀者了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years here teaches you patterns.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡工作十年，什麼套路都看懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is this edition different from that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz ði ɪˈdɪʒən ˈdɪfərənt frʌm ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這個版本跟那個有什麼不同？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same story, clearer print and stiffer pages.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈstɔri ˈklɪr prɪnt ænd ˈstɪfər ˈpeɪdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 內容一樣，但這本印刷更清晰、紙更硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the older printing then?
dialogue.zh: 那這是舊的印刷版嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the new cover arrives in June.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə nju ˈkʌvər əˈraɪvz ɪn dʒun/
dialogue.zh: 對，新封面六月才會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait for the new cover?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪt fər ðə nju ˈkʌvər/
dialogue.zh: 我該等新的封面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, the inside stays exactly the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈrɪəli ði ɪnˈsaɪd steɪz ɪɡˈzæktli ðə seɪm/
dialogue.zh: 不用，裡頭的內容完全一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I hate waiting for books.
dialogue.zh: 好，我最討厭等書了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, a bookstore window helps though.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu ə ˈbʊkˌstɔr ˈwɪnˌdoʊ hɛlpz ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不過看看書店櫥窗會好一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there clip lights for reading?
dialogue.zh: 有閱讀用的夾式小燈嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clip ones hang near the cash register.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪp wʌnz hæŋ nɪr ðə kæʃ ˈrɛdʒɪstər/
dialogue.zh: 夾式的小燈掛在收銀台附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now these children's books are adorable.
dialogue.zh: 這些童書真的太可愛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bunny series is a huge hit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌni ˈsɪriz ɪz ə hjuʤ hɪt/
dialogue.zh: 小兔子系列超級受歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What ages are these picture books for?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈeɪdʒəz ɑr ðiz ˈpɪktʃər bʊks fər/
dialogue.zh: 這些繪本適合幾歲的孩子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most suit three to six year olds.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst suːt θri tə sɪks jɪr ˈoʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 多數適合三到六歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My niece turns four next month.
dialogue.zh: 我姪女下個月就四歲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this one is her perfect match.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs wʌn ɪz hɜr ˈpɜrfɪkt mætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那這本跟她的年齡剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the words simple enough for her?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə wɜrdz ˈsɪmpəl ɪˈnʌf fər hər/
dialogue.zh: 裡面的字對她夠簡單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very, each page has just one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri iʧ peɪdʒ hæz dʒʌst wʌn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 非常簡單，每頁只有一行字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this book come with any stickers?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs bʊk kʌm wɪð ˈɛni ˈstɪkərz/
dialogue.zh: 這本書附貼紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten shiny ones at the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɛn ˈʃaɪni wʌnz æt ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 有，最後面有十張亮亮的貼紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids love stickers more than stories.
dialogue.zh: 小孩愛貼紙勝過愛故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but stories sneak in anyway.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，但故事還是會偷偷住進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like how you put that.
dialogue.zh: 你這個說法真動人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I tell every parent here the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɛl ˈɛvri ˈpɛrənt hɪr ðə seɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我對店裡的每位家長都這麼說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This dictionary looks extremely thick.
dialogue.zh: 這本辭典看起來超級厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The thickest we own, fully updated too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈθɪkɪst wi ˈoʊn ˈfʊli ʌpˈdetɪd tu/
dialogue.zh: 是我們最厚的一本，而且全面更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it include example sentences?
dialogue.zh: 裡面有例句嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every entry shows two or three.
dialogue.zh: 每個詞條都有兩三個例句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old dictionary misses many words.
dialogue.zh: 我的舊辭典少了很多字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one adds five thousand newer terms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ædz faɪv ˈθaʊzənd ˈnuər tɜrmz/
dialogue.zh: 這本新增了五千個新詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for my English classes, then.
dialogue.zh: 那對我的英文課剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Students grab it before exams every year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstudənts ɡræb ɪt bɪˈfɔr ɪɡˈzæmz ˈɛvri jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 學生每年考前都會來搶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there smaller ones for travel?
dialogue.zh: 有沒有適合出國帶的袖珍版？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pocket sizes sit in that bottom row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑkɪt ˈsaɪzəz sɪt ɪn ðæt ˈbɑtəm roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 袖珍版放在最下面那排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one fits right in my jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn fɪts raɪt ɪn maɪ ˈdʒækɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這本剛剛好放進外套口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Handy for quiet cafes and planes.
dialogue.zh: 在安靜的咖啡廳和飛機上都方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any books for learning Chinese?
dialogue.zh: 有學中文的書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our language wall covers six languages.
dialogue.zh: 語言書牆涵蓋六種語言。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which book starts completely from zero?
dialogue.zh: 哪本是完全從零開始的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This friendly one uses pictures first.
dialogue.zh: 這本很親切，先從圖片開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cookbooks caught my eye over there.
dialogue.zh: 那邊的食譜書吸引了我的目光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The baking corner almost smells real.
dialogue.zh: 烘焙那一角幾乎讓人聞到香味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I find every ingredient here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡買得到所有食材嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most use things from any market.
dialogue.zh: 多半用一般市場買得到的材料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want easy weekday dinner ideas.
dialogue.zh: 我想要平日晚餐的簡單靈感。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This chapter promises meals under twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈtʃæptər ˈprɑmɪsəz milz ˈʌndər ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 這一章保證二十分鐘內上桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold, I am taking this home today.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld aɪ æm ˈteɪkɪŋ ðɪs hoʊm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 決定了，今天就要帶它回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your family will eat wonderfully this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈfæməli wɪl it ˈwʌndərfuli ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 這週你的家人會吃得很幸福。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the science section on this floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsaɪəns ˈsɛkʃən ɑn ðɪs flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 科學區在這層樓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Space books sit closest to the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /speɪs bʊks sɪt ˈkloʊsɪst tə ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太空書擺在最靠近窗邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These photos of Mars are stunning.
dialogue.zh: 這些火星的照片太震撼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The telescope club stops by weekly.
dialogue.zh: 天文社每週都會上門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You lend books here as well?
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡也外借書籍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only classics, return within two weeks.
dialogue.zh: 只有經典名著，兩週內歸還。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That saves money on old favorites.
dialogue.zh: 重讀舊愛就省錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Borrow it, love it, then buy your copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑroʊ ɪt lʌv ɪt ðɛn baɪ jɔr ˈkɑpi/
dialogue.zh: 先借回去，愛上它，再買自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart plan, you thought of everything.
dialogue.zh: 好聰明的計畫，什麼都幫你想好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Regulars keep us full of ideas.
dialogue.zh: 常客給了我們很多靈感。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this atlas the classroom version?
dialogue.zh: 這本是教室用的地圖集嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this is the compact desk one.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðɪs ɪz ðə kəmˈpækt dɛsk wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不是，這是書桌用的縮小版。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The classroom one shows more street maps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈklæsˌrum wʌn ʃoʊz mɔr strit mæps/
dialogue.zh: 教室版有更多街道地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, want me to check our stock?
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt wɑnt mi tə tʃɛk ˈaʊər stɑk/
dialogue.zh: 正確，要我先查一下庫存嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, that would help a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ðæt wʊd hɛlp ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 好，拜託，那會幫很大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me one moment at the computer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi wʌn ˈmoʊmənt æt ðə kəmˈpjutər/
dialogue.zh: 稍等我一下，我在電腦前查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, take as long as you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr teɪk əz lɔŋ əz ju nid/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，你慢慢查，不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, keep browsing while you wait.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，等的時候可以繼續逛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, did you find that atlas?
dialogue.zh: 所以，找到那本地圖集了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one new copy on the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn nju ˈkɑpi ɑn ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，桌上有一本全新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I will take it with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪ wɪl teɪk ɪt wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這本我要帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classroom maps are a smart pick.
dialogue.zh: 教室版的地圖真是好選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which novel won your shop award?
dialogue.zh: 哪本小說得過你們店的獎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This quiet story of a lighthouse keeper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkwaɪət ˈstɔri əv ə ˈlaɪtˌhaʊs ˈkipər/
dialogue.zh: 這本安靜的燈塔看守故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lighthouse stories feel calm somehow.
dialogue.zh: 燈塔故事不知為何讓人平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Readers call it a warm blanket.
dialogue.zh: 讀者說它像一條暖毯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I really want to read it.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ ˈrɪəli wɑnt tə rid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我現在真的好想讀它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it home, curl up tonight.
dialogue.zh: 帶回家，今晚窩起來讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it use big comfortable print?
dialogue.zh: 它用的是大而舒適的字體嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium size, easy on tired eyes.
dialogue.zh: 中等字級，久看不累眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes appreciate that greatly.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛非常感謝這點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too after a long shift.
dialogue.zh: 我站完長班也一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are on your feet all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ɑn jɔr fit ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你們整天都站著走動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly walking, shelves need constant tidying.
dialogue.zh: 大多是走動，書架得隨時整理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I noticed, everything looks spotless.
dialogue.zh: 我發現了，一切看起來一塵不染。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Messy shelves hide books from buyers.
dialogue.zh: 亂掉的書架會把書藏起來賣不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes total sense to me.
dialogue.zh: 這對我來說完全有道理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you see anything else you like?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju si ˈɛnɪˌθɪŋ ɛls ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 還看到什麼喜歡的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a planner for the new year.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ˈplænər fər ðə nju jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 有，一本新年用的行事曆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Planners live beside the greeting cards.
dialogue.zh: 行事曆本在賀卡旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This dotted one feels just right.
dialogue.zh: 這本點陣格的手感剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A solid choice, you have taste.
dialogue.zh: 選得真穩，你有品味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any sign of the sequel yet?
dialogue.zh: 這本的續集有消息了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, it prints next month.
dialogue.zh: 還沒，下個月才印好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I reserve one before it arrives?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɪˈzɜrv wʌn bɪˈfɔr ɪt əˈraɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 到貨前我可以先預約一本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, reservations opened this morning.
dialogue.zh: 可以，預約今天早上才剛開放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do the reservations work exactly?
dialogue.zh: 預約的流程到底是怎樣的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We write your name, you pay later.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi raɪt jɔr neɪm ju peɪ ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 我們先記下你的名字，之後再付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you phone me when it comes in?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju foʊn mi wɛn ɪt kʌmz ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 書到會打電話給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We text instead, calls get missed.
dialogue.zh: 我們改傳簡訊，電話常漏接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Texting works much better for me.
dialogue.zh: 傳簡訊對我方便太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just leave your number on this form.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst liv jɔr ˈnʌmbər ɑn ðɪs fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 在這張單上留個號碼就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pay the whole price now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ peɪ ðə hoʊl praɪs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在要付全額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just half today secures your copy.
dialogue.zh: 先付一半，書就為您留住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I change my mind later?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ tʃeɪndʒ maɪ maɪnd ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 如果之後我改主意了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cancel before arrival, full refund.
dialogue.zh: 到貨前取消，全額退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds completely fair to me.
dialogue.zh: 這聽起來對我完全公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We prefer happy readers, not pressure.
dialogue.zh: 我們要的是開心的讀者，不是壓力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the first book sold out here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə fɜrst bʊk soʊld aʊt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 第一本在這裡賣光了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sadly yes, three copies went yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 很可惜，昨天就賣了三本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will another shipment come sooner?
dialogue.zh: 可以早一點補貨進來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our next truck arrives on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我們下次送貨車週五到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday works, I will swing by.
dialogue.zh: 週五可以，我會順路過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep an eye out for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip æn aɪ aʊt fər ju/
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你留意的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign up for a card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ saɪn ʌp fər ə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 我該辦一張會員卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the card is free and simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə kɑrd ɪz fri ænd ˈsɪmpəl/
dialogue.zh: 有，卡片免費又簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do members actually get?
dialogue.zh: 會員到底有什麼好處？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Points on purchases and early sale invites.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnts ɑn ˈpɜrtʃəsəz ænd ˈɜrli seɪl ɪnˈvaɪts/
dialogue.zh: 消費累積點數，還有特賣提前邀請。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early invites sound very appealing.
dialogue.zh: 提前邀請聽起來很吸引我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sale mornings beat the weekend crowds.
dialogue.zh: 特賣日上午可以避開週末人潮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many points does one book earn?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni paɪnts dʌz wʌn bʊk ɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 一本書可以累積多少點數？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One per dollar, ten gets a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pər ˈdɑlər tɛn ɡɛts ə ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 一美元一點，滿十點換禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A free gift? That is generous.
dialogue.zh: 免費禮物？也太大方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually fancy pens or canvas totes.
dialogue.zh: 通常是質感筆或帆布袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I collect totes, that seals it.
dialogue.zh: 我愛收集提袋，就這樣決定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign up now, it takes two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪn ʌp naʊ ɪt teɪks tu ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 現在辦吧，只要兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What details do you need?
dialogue.zh: 需要登記什麼資料？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Email alone works, no paperwork needed.
dialogue.zh: 只要留電子郵件就行，不用紙本表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My email is saved in my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈimˌeɪl ɪz seɪvd ɪn maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我的電子郵件記在手機裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, say it and I will enter it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd seɪ ɪt ænd aɪ wɪl ˈɛntər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請唸出來，我幫你輸入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is coming for a signing?
dialogue.zh: 誰會來辦簽名會？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A famous illustrator signs on Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 一位有名的插畫家週六來簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The illustrator of the bunny books?
dialogue.zh: 是小兔子繪本那位插畫家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly who, kids adore him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli hu kɪdz əˈdɔr hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 就是他，小孩超愛他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he sign the book I buy?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl hi saɪn ðə bʊk aɪ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他會幫我買的書簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring any copy from our shelves.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs brɪŋ ˈɛni ˈkɑpi frʌm ˈaʊər ʃɛlvz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，從我們架上買的都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a long line for signings?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə lɔŋ laɪn fər ˈsaɪnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 簽名會排隊會很長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A short one, doors open at two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃɔrt wʌn dɔrz ˈoʊpən æt tu/
dialogue.zh: 不會長，兩點開放入場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a photo with him?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈfoʊtoʊ wɪð hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我可以跟他合照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one quick photo per guest.
dialogue.zh: 可以，每位賓客拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he write my daughter's name?
dialogue.zh: 他會寫上我女兒的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Personal notes are his signature move.
dialogue.zh: 寫個人獻詞是他的招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will jump for joy, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的她會高興得跳起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then come early and I will save seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kʌm ˈɜrli ænd aɪ wɪl seɪv sits/
dialogue.zh: 那就早一點來，我會幫你留位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are events free for visitors?
dialogue.zh: 活動對顧客都免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signings are free, talks sell small tickets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪnɪŋz ɑr fri tɔks sɛl smɔl ˈtɪkɪts/
dialogue.zh: 簽名會免費，演講賣小額票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is speaking at the evening talk?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ˈspikɪŋ æt ði ˈivnɪŋ tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 晚上的演講是誰來主講？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A historian telling stories of this old city.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hɪˈstɔriən ˈtɛlɪŋ ˈstɔriz əv ðɪs ɑld ˈsɪti/
dialogue.zh: 一位歷史學家講這座老城的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That topic sounds right up my alley.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈtɑpɪk saʊndz raɪt ʌp maɪ ˈæleɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這個主題完全對我的胃口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can grab his book upstairs.
dialogue.zh: 你可以到樓上拿他的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are seats kept for members?
dialogue.zh: 會員有保留座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The front two rows are, just ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frʌnt tu roʊz ɑr dʒʌst æsk/
dialogue.zh: 前兩排是，跟我們說一聲就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my friend come along too?
dialogue.zh: 我朋友可以一起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring the card and show it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs brɪŋ ðə kɑrd ænd ʃoʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，帶著會員卡給他看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people came to the last one?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl keɪm tə ðə læst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 上次活動來了多少人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost forty, standing room only.
dialogue.zh: 將近四十人，連站的位置都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, this store hosts real events.
dialogue.zh: 哇，這間店真的在辦活動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We love being more than a shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lʌv ˈbin mɔr ðæn ə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 我們想成為不只是賣書的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this store do story hours?
dialogue.zh: 這裡有說故事的時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday mornings, story time for little ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋz ˈstɔri taɪm fər ˈlɪtəl wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 週六早上，專為小小孩說故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Story time? That is so sweet.
dialogue.zh: 故事時間？太溫馨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids sit on the rainbow rug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɪdz sɪt ɑn ðə ˈreɪnˌboʊ rʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 小孩們坐在彩虹地毯上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my niece need to read first?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz maɪ nis nid tə rid fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我姪女要先會讀書才能參加嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, she just listens and has fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʃi dʒʌst ˈlɪsənz ænd hæz fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，她只要聽就好、玩得開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can parents stay and listen too?
dialogue.zh: 家長也可以留下來一起聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, many stay with coffee.
dialogue.zh: 當然，很多家長邊喝咖啡邊聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a book club around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə bʊk klʌb əˈraʊnd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這附近有讀書會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we meet on the last Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi mit ɑn ðə læst ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有，我們每月最後一個週四聚會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which book is the club reading?
dialogue.zh: 讀書會現在讀哪一本？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A family saga set in a small town.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfæməli ˈsɑɡə sɛt ɪn ə smɔl taʊn/
dialogue.zh: 一本講小鎮家族的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it a sad book or a hopeful one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ə sæd bʊk ɔr ə ˈhoʊpfəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 是悲傷的，還是充滿希望的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hopeful, with a few tears in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhoʊpfəl wɪð ə fjuʊ tɪrz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 充滿希望，中間難免有些眼淚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I read it all before the meeting?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ rid ɪt ɔl bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 聚會前我得先讀完嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people do, but nobody checks.
dialogue.zh: 多數人會讀完，但沒人查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That lowers pressure a lot, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 這樣壓力小多了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Discussion matters more than homework.
dialogue.zh: 討論比功課重要多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I join the book club list?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ dʒɔɪn ðə bʊk klʌb lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼加入讀書會名單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add your name to the sign-up sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd jɔr neɪm tə ðə ˈsaɪn ʌp ʃit/
dialogue.zh: 先在報名表上寫名字就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is space for two names.
dialogue.zh: 還留得下兩個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then write yours and your friend's.
dialogue.zh: 那就把你的和朋友的名字都寫上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The reading group starts at seven?
dialogue.zh: 讀書會七點開始對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and it runs about an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ænd ɪt rʌnz əˈbaʊt ən ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 對，大約進行一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will be back Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 完美，我週四會再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will save you a warm corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl seɪv ju ə wɔrm ˈkɔːrnər/
dialogue.zh: 我們會幫你留個舒適的角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the store close during events?
dialogue.zh: 活動期間店裡會休息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the shop stays open as usual.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ʃɑp steɪz ˈoʊpən æz ˈuʒuəl/
dialogue.zh: 不會，活動期間也照常開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep reserved books?
dialogue.zh: 你們把預約的書放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelf behind the counter holds them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkaʊntər hoʊldz ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台後面的架子就是放它們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will you hold my order?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ju hoʊld maɪ ˈɔːrdər/
dialogue.zh: 我的訂單可以保留多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One week, then it goes back.
dialogue.zh: 一週，之後書就退回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A week is plenty, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 一週綽綽有餘，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are all set, see you Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ɔl sɛt si ju ˈfraɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 都搞定了，週五見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello again, is this the checkout line?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ əˈɡɛn ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你好，這邊是結帳排隊的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just place your books here.
dialogue.zh: 是的，把書放在這裡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about paying by phone instead?
dialogue.zh: 那可以用手機支付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap your phone right here.
dialogue.zh: 可以，手機在這裡輕點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is cash still okay too?
dialogue.zh: 付現金也還可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, though many people tap now.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，只是現在多數人都刷手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with this card?
dialogue.zh: 我可以用這張卡付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, insert or tap works.
dialogue.zh: 當然，插卡或感應都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell gift cards here?
dialogue.zh: 你們有賣禮券嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, any amount from ten up.
dialogue.zh: 有，金額從十美元起都可以挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you wrap this one as a gift?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju wræp ðɪs wʌn æz ə ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 這本可以幫我包裝成禮物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wrap for free, pick a paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wræp fər fri pɪk ə ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 我們免費包裝，挑張包裝紙吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will go with the blue paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡoʊ wɪð ðə blu ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 我要藍色那張包裝紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice choice, blue is very popular.
dialogue.zh: 選得好，藍色非常受歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you add a card inside?
dialogue.zh: 裡面可以附一張卡片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what message should I write?
dialogue.zh: 可以，要寫什麼話呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just write, happy birthday from Uncle.
dialogue.zh: 就寫：叔叔祝你生日快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it looks very smart.
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，看起來很體面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What will my total be?
dialogue.zh: 總共多少錢呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That comes to thirty two dollars.
dialogue.zh: 總共是三十二美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a printed receipt?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我一張列印收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, here you go.
dialogue.zh: 當然，給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any student discounts around here?
dialogue.zh: 你們有學生優惠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show your card and save ten percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃaʊ jɔr kɑrd ænd seɪv tɛn pərˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 有，出示學生證就打九折。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I earn points on today's books?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɜrn paɪnts ɑn təˈdeɪz bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 今天的書可以累積點數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, members get one point per dollar.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈmɛmbərz ɡɛt wʌn pɔɪnt pər ˈdɑlər/
dialogue.zh: 可以，會員一美元累積一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the blue train book come in?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə blu treɪn bʊk kʌm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友找的那本藍色火車封面書到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wrapped and waiting right here.
dialogue.zh: 好了，包好放在這裡等你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will everything fit in one bag?
dialogue.zh: 這些都裝得進一個袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bags will hold them safely.
dialogue.zh: 用兩個袋子才拿得安穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, this pile weighs a ton.
dialogue.zh: 哇，這疊書重得嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing the counter is sturdy.
dialogue.zh: 好在收銀台夠結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any special offer right now?
dialogue.zh: 現在有什麼特惠活動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy three, get one free today.
dialogue.zh: 今天買三送一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I need one more small one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ nid wʌn mɔr smɔl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那我還要再挑一本小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the slim ones by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə slɪm wʌnz baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 試試門邊那幾本薄薄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that café yours as well?
dialogue.zh: 那邊的咖啡區也是你們的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is part of our store.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ɪz pɑrt əv ˈaʊər stɔr/
dialogue.zh: 對，它是我們店的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I order at your counter?
dialogue.zh: 咖啡要在你們櫃台點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the café has its own line.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə kæˈfeɪ hæz ɪts oʊn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，咖啡區有自己排隊的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the coffee any good here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的咖啡好喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We roast our own beans here.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡豆是我們自己現烘的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take my drink to the chairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk maɪ drɪŋk tə ðə tʃɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 飲品可以端到座位區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lidded cups only, please no open ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪdɪd kʌps ˈoʊnli pliz noʊ ˈoʊpən wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 只要有蓋子的杯子，沒蓋子的不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lidded cup is fine then.
dialogue.zh: 那有蓋子的杯子沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The armchairs face the big window.
dialogue.zh: 大沙發椅都面向大窗戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a pot of tea?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə pɑt əv ti/
dialogue.zh: 一壺茶多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four fifty, with honey if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈfɪfti wɪð ˈhʌni ɪf ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 四塊五，想加蜂蜜也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This latte smells wonderful.
dialogue.zh: 這杯拿鐵聞起來太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is our seasonal cinnamon flavor.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們季節限定的肉桂口味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sit here while I read?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɪt hɪr hwaɪl aɪ rid/
dialogue.zh: 我可以坐在這裡看書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, nobody minds at all.
dialogue.zh: 當然，沒有人會在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somewhere quiet still free?
dialogue.zh: 還有安靜的地方空著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small table by the plants.
dialogue.zh: 植物旁邊那張小桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could stay here all afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡待整個下午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many regulars do, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，很多常客都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that big armchair free?
dialogue.zh: 那張大沙發椅是空的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, it belongs to nobody.
dialogue.zh: 去坐吧，它不屬於任何人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I refill my water here?
dialogue.zh: 我的水可以在這裡續杯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the fountain is near the restrooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈfaʊntən ɪz nɪr ðə ˈrɛstˌrumz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，飲水機在洗手間附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I leave the tray?
dialogue.zh: 托盤要放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just set it at the counter.
dialogue.zh: 放到櫃台上就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Books and coffee belong together.
dialogue.zh: 書和咖啡本來就該在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly why we set it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli waʊ wi sɛt ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我們正是為此才設了咖啡區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my new member card ready?
dialogue.zh: 我的新會員卡可以領了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, printed just now.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，剛印好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, you are so quick.
dialogue.zh: 真快，效率太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it for birthday free drinks.
dialogue.zh: 生日還能用它換免費飲品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A free drink on my birthday?
dialogue.zh: 生日有免費飲品？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A free drink, plus double points.
dialogue.zh: 一杯免費飲品，還有兩倍點數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful, I will use it today.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，我今天就用它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It already has your points on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɔlˈrɛdi hæz jɔr pɔɪnts ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 卡上已經幫你積好點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you email me event invites?
dialogue.zh: 活動邀請會發郵件給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus early notice of sales.
dialogue.zh: 會的，特價也會提前通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any big event this month?
dialogue.zh: 這個月有大活動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A writing contest, details inside.
dialogue.zh: 有寫作比賽，詳情在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the contest only for kids?
dialogue.zh: 比賽只給小孩參加嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, adults have their own group.
dialogue.zh: 不是，大人有另外的組別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My novel sits in a drawer.
dialogue.zh: 我寫的小說一直放在抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then enter it, you never know.
dialogue.zh: 那就投稿吧，說不定呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do winners get published?
dialogue.zh: 獲獎作品會被出版嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The twelve best appear in print.
dialogue.zh: 十二篇最好的會印成書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is wild, maybe I will.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，說不定我真會參加。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form waits at the desk.
dialogue.zh: 報名表就放在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy stamps here too?
dialogue.zh: 這裡也可以買郵票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but the kiosk next door does.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bət ðə ˈkiˌɑsk nɛkst dɔr dʌz/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，但隔壁超商有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these paper bags recycled?
dialogue.zh: 這些紙袋是回收紙做的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and reuse them for points.
dialogue.zh: 是的，帶回來重用還給點數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you ship online orders?
dialogue.zh: 你們網路訂單會出貨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, same price as in store.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du seɪm praɪs æz ɪn stɔr/
dialogue.zh: 會的，價格和店內一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do rare titles come from?
dialogue.zh: 那些罕見的書是哪來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small presses visit us each spring.
dialogue.zh: 每年春天都有小出版社來拜訪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you worked here?
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡工作多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Since college, ten years this April.
dialogue.zh: 從大學起，到今年四月就十年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you read all you sell?
dialogue.zh: 賣的書你都會讀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I try, maybe six books a year.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ traɪ ˈmeɪbi sɪks bʊks ə jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我盡量，一年大概讀六本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I had a great visit.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這趟來得真愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back soon, we open at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm bæk sun wi ˈoʊpən æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 快再來喔，我們九點開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have a nice evening, see you soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə naɪs ˈivnɪŋ si ju sun/
dialogue.zh: 祝你有個美好的晚上，再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, happy reading.
dialogue.zh: 你也是，讀書愉快。
